about: Research data files under data/research that no non-test file in src/ or scripts/ reads, and why (tests/guards/research-data-has-reader.test.ts). rawSource entries are evidence the game is not meant to read. awaitingReader entries are research waiting for the code that should read it: that list may only shrink (the guard holds it at or under its ceiling), so an entry must leave in the same change that gives its file a reader. Each names its engine and the squad that owns its reader, from docs/codex/audit-by-engine-2026-10-01.md. A new data file with no reader and no entry fails the guard.

rawSource.reason: Raw enacted-bill sample, the evidence the lever table and docs/research/bill-samples were measured from; the game reads what was measured, not the sample.
Raw enacted-bill sample, the evidence the lever table and docs/research/bill-samples were measured from; the game reads what was measured, not the sample.

Raw research result for the open stopgap rows (value, spread, sources, one-line builder note each); builders apply a row into the game's own data and resolve its stopgap (pool item research-stopgaps-oct19-apply), the game never reads the file.
Scan output listing the placeholder and unresearched markers found in src on one commit; evidence for the stopgap audit, not game data.
Research on the number stand-ins open on Oct 12, 2026 (class, current value, recommended value or bounds, source); builders apply rows into the parameter tables.

Raw Census 2022 shares of local spending by type of government; scripts/research/export-public-budget-bases.py measures each place's county and city base rows from it into data/research/money/public-budget-bases.json, which the budgets engine reads.

awaitingReader.reason: Law catalog terms, batch 2; src/simulation/law-consequences/legal-outcome.ts cites it as a source but nothing reads the file. Owner: the Coordinator owns the shared law path the catalog feeds.
The 61 kinds of bill part (04 SYSTEM SPECS, spec 3); no bill builder reads it yet. Owner: Team 1 owns lawmaking, where bill parts are built.
Dated minimum-wage rows for all 56 places, to be integrated into the starting-law wage terms; the file says no game code reads it. Owner: Team 3 owns pay and jobs.
State populations for 2024; nothing reads them yet. Owner: an electorate is population times turnout (A110).

Sourced callback gaps from field experiments, waiting for the hiring engine to read employer attitudes (pool items world-hiring-bias-reasons and world-sale-eligibility-reads); nothing in the engine reads it yet. Owner: Team 3 owns pay and jobs, where an employer's answer to an applicant is decided.
